q: When will the speakers and agenda be announced?
a: Soon. We're finalising the 2026 lineup now, and tracks, the agenda and speakers will go up on this page as they're confirmed. Passes are already on sale, so you don't have to wait to get yours.

q: How do I get a pass?
a: Passes are sold on KonfHub at https://konfhub.com/devfest-kochi-26. There are 300 seats and they're released in tiers, so once a tier closes its price is gone. Earlier editions sold out.

Full-day access to the keynotes, talks and workshops, the community lounge and sponsor booths, DevFest swag, and food and refreshments through the day. The student pass also includes a certificate of participation.
Your ticket confirmation from KonfHub, and a laptop with a charger if you want to join a workshop. Workshop setup instructions will be shared once the agenda is out.

q: Can I speak, sponsor or volunteer?
a: Yes. Write to hello@gdgcochin.org and tell us what you have in mind.

q: Is there a code of conduct?
a: Yes. DevFest Kochi follows the Google Developer Groups community guidelines. Everyone attending, speaking, sponsoring or volunteering agrees to keep it a harassment-free space.
Email us at hello@gdgcochin.org and someone from the GDG Cochin team will get back to you.

q: Is anything hidden on this site?
a: Maybe. Four coupons, one checkout each, first come first served. The years line up by date, not by number. The hosts would like a badge of their own. Get lost and you might catch a ferry. And the fishing net at the venue is always hungry.
